reason: The money is nothing to me, and I would like a cheap way to watch what my site staff spend while I'm abroad. But uploading a whole work-chat export to a Telegram bot and letting it write into my Google Drive is exactly the kind of access I don't hand to a tool I found while scrolling.
objection: A bot reading my work group and getting into my Google account. On top of that, I expect it to misread faded or handwritten Indonesian nota, and then I'm the one fixing rows from abroad.
would_change_my_mind: A free check I could run on a ZIP of receipts with no Google connection and no chat export, showing it catches real duplicates and reads handwritten nota correctly, plus a written explanation of exactly what Drive access it needs.
